# EKO Perspectives project instructions

When working on any EKO Perspectives post or editorial task in this repository, first read `.editorial/EKO_EDITORIAL_WORKFLOW_v2.2.md` and follow the stage routing inside it. When selecting a structure for a new article, use `.editorial/EKO_ENGINE_LIBRARY.md` as an adaptive menu rather than a fixed template.

The repository's **EKO Editorial Workflow v2.2** is authoritative and supersedes the older separate `pre2015-prose-voice` and `ai-slop-editing-pass` workflow.

Do not publish or modify published posts without explicit owner approval. New posts stay `draft: true`. Preserve the workflow's evidence, voice, anti-slop, SEO/discovery, image and rendered-page QA stages in their stated order. SEO is packaging, not a writing brief.

The workflow is adaptive. Do not reproduce a fixed EKO article template simply because earlier posts used one. Structure follows the subject; first person is optional; caution is not the default ending; and a clear position is allowed when the evidence supports it proportionately.

`.editorial/EKO_TOPIC_BACKLOG.md` is a non-binding planning file. Do not draft from it automatically. Re-check the factual premise, confirm public-source availability, and obtain owner approval for the topic and angle first.

Every published post needs at least one relevant lead image stored locally with descriptive alt text and any required credit or licence. A second image is used only when it adds genuine explanatory, documentary or historical value; do not add decorative stock filler.
